types.description: A settings group: one thing an application must be told to run (a database connection, an LLM provider, a payment account). Each field is one setting, named in the environment as <GROUP>_<FIELD> in upper snake case (Database.url is DATABASE_URL) unless the field's @envName says otherwise. A field marked @secret has its value in a vault and never in the model, the repository or generated output. A settings group has no source, so it generates no table, query or route (core's entity generator types it as it does a value object); the configuration generators read it (.env.example, the key manifest, .keys-axi.toml).
types.whenToUse: Every environment variable, secret or build argument an application reads. Group the ones that change together; a setting is a field, so it carries its type, @required, @default and validators the same way an entity field does.

types.description: Where a vault keeps one environment's secrets. Its name is the environment's name in the model (the same name a deployment's environment uses), so a deployment finds its scope by name.
types.whenToUse: One per environment that reads secrets from the vault: dev, staging, production.

attrs.name: env
attrs.description: The store's environment slug (Infisical's dev, staging, prod). Absent, the scope's own name.

attrs.name: project
attrs.description: The store's own name for the place: for Infisical, the project slug or id.

types.description: An Infisical secret store. It names where the values of @secret settings live, per environment, through its scope.env children; the values never appear in the model. The reference to an entry is derived: a secret setting is read under its environment name, in the scope the vault maps to the environment being deployed.
types.whenToUse: A project whose secrets live in Infisical. The .keys-axi.toml generator writes its scopes for keys-axi, so `keys-axi run` needs no project flag.

attrs.name: defaultScope
attrs.description: The name of the scope.env child used when no environment is given: written to .keys-axi.toml as its top-level scope and default_environment.

attrs.name: envName
attrs.description: On a setting: its environment variable name, when the derived <GROUP>_<FIELD> is wrong (DB_POOL_SIZE rather than DATABASE_POOL_SIZE). Upper case letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Read only on settings.

attrs.name: phase
attrs.description: On a setting: when the application reads it. runtime (the meaning when absent) is read by the running process; build is a build-time variable, such as a Docker build argument. Read only on settings.

attrs.name: secret
attrs.description: On a setting (a field of an object.settings): the value is a secret. It lives in a vault, is never printed, and generated files carry its name only. A secret setting may not declare @default. Read only on settings.
